function.name: Procurement
function.description: Sourcing, comparing, contracting with and monitoring suppliers.

jobs.name: Classify spend into categories for analysis
jobs.outcome: Every transaction and line item is classified into the spend taxonomy consistently enough to negotiate on.

jobs.name: Compare supplier quotes on a like-for-like basis
jobs.outcome: Quotes with different structures are normalized and compared, with the differences that matter called out.

jobs.name: Draft a request for proposal from requirements
jobs.outcome: A stakeholder's requirements become an RFP that suppliers can answer without clarification rounds.

jobs.name: Monitor suppliers for risk signals
jobs.outcome: Financial, delivery, compliance and news signals about suppliers are watched and surfaced before they become incidents.
